name: Privasia Technology Berhad
overview: 2026年，Privasia Technology Berhad 获得 MITI 批准在 Bagan Datuk, Perak 开发数据中心项目，并完成对 Djava Factory Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权的收购（因未达利润保证，支付余额对价）。公司业务线未发生整体退出或新增，但数据中心项目为新的业务方向。
overview_en: In 2026, Privasia Technology Berhad obtained MITI approval for a data centre project in Bagan Datuk, Perak, and completed the acquisition of 51% equity interest in Djava Factory Sdn. Bhd. (with balance consideration paid due to unmet profit guarantee). No business line was exited or newly added, but the data centre project represents a new business direction.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面推进数据中心项目及收购 Djava Factory 股权。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the Company progressed a data centre project and acquired equity interest in Djava Factory.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: MITI 批准 Silver Streams Technofarm Sdn Bhd 在 Bagan Datuk, Perak 开发数据中心项目，条件包括确保最大需求 50 MW 的离网能源供应。
actions.text_en: MITI approved Silver Streams Technofarm Sdn Bhd's application for the development of a Data Centre Project in Bagan Datuk, Perak, subject to conditions including securing an off-grid energy supply with a maximum demand of 50 MW.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就收购 Djava Factory Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权，因 DJF 未能达成利润保证，Privasia 将支付余额对价 RM330,000.00（分两期各 15%）。
actions.text_en: In relation to the acquisition of 51% equity interest in Djava Factory Sdn. Bhd., as DJF failed to meet the profit guarantee, Privasia shall pay the balance purchase consideration of RM330,000.00 in two instalments of 15% each.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 通过 Silver Streams Technofarm Sdn Bhd 进入数据中心开发业务（Bagan Datuk, Perak 项目获 MITI 批准）。
model_changes.text_en: Entered data centre development business through Silver Streams Technofarm Sdn Bhd (MITI approval obtained for the project in Bagan Datuk, Perak).
